announcement.title: Start fresh, agent tasks and steadier routines
announcement.description:
Fixes: Routines and agent replies now carry on after Halofy restarts, and a routine that fails to start is tried again. Opening an agent and the Routines list in agent details recover on their own after a brief connection drop; if the computer stays out of reach, you see “Can’t reach this computer right now…” instead of an error code. Playbooks now say why they are unavailable and offer the fix. Agent chats no longer show thread settlement notices, the sidebar no longer shows combined agent status chips, and the “Show full message” link is easier to read.

Improvements: Start fresh gives a saved agent a clean chat after it writes a short carry-over note. Open it from the context meter, the agent’s menu or by typing /clear, on desktop, web and phone. Agent details now has a Tasks checklist that you can edit and the agent keeps up to date. Your saved agents can ask your saved agents on your other computers for help, and the reply comes back to their chat; a Halofy window must be connected to both computers. After updating the browser extension, its side panel follows the app’s theme and its connect screen shows clear progress and plain-language errors.

Known issues: The browser extension’s side panel does not show uploaded wallpapers. Windows installers remain unsigned. Add to Chrome remains disabled until the Chrome Web Store listing is updated.
